dispositions.local_proposition: Pairwise applicant identifiers and minimized presentations can satisfy local disclosure requirements.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires intended minimized stable identifiers, securing metadata visible across relying contexts and unlinkability claim; actual repeated key reference/proof metadata or timing join must be tested. Stable credential payload identifiers alone are not this mechanism.
dispositions.trigger: A verifier, colluding verifiers, or another observer can link otherwise separate interactions using stable or distinctive securing-mechanism data while the system still reports the intended privacy property as satisfied.
falsification: The system returns PASS for unlinkability while repeated or otherwise distinctive proof metadata links interactions across contexts.
Privacy analysis inspects only the credential payload and excludes observable securing-mechanism metadata that materially enables correlation.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate full proof and key-reference exposure across contexts; withhold unlinkability claim absent evidence; preserve legitimate within-community correlation.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: evaluate proof metadata across complete interactions; submit already identifies residual credential correlation.

Privacy analysis inspects only the credential payload and excludes observable securing-mechanism metadata that materially enables correlation.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Test actual credential proof metadata across contexts; do not confuse ordinary member DID correlation with this securing-mechanism-specific case.
dispositions.comparison: not established within selected profile; additional source-grounded premises required before mapping. Existing safe control remains a conditional diagnostic, not a finding.

dispositions.sections: Submit Meeting it: credential signature, validity, revocation; VTI-CMP-060–064
dispositions.local_proposition: Credential status check can be correct and minimal in result.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Status resolution does not reveal where or when applicant presented credential.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires observable status interaction and privacy objective limiting issuer/provider knowledge; actual request metadata/timing must permit presentation inference. No particular status technology assumed.
dispositions.trigger: The status-resolution event exposes a credential-specific or context-specific observation that permits usage correlation, while the verification flow still treats privacy assurance as satisfied.
falsification: The system reports PASS for the privacy proposition even though the status provider can associate credential-specific requests with distinct presentation events.
Assessment examines only the content of the status response and ignores privacy-significant metadata created by making the lookup.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate observer and request metadata, not response alone; use privacy-preserving resolution where required or qualify claim.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant; issuer knowledge of community application.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: combines presentation and status-resolution observations; local task already requires status verification.

falsification: The system reports PASS for the privacy proposition even though the status provider can associate credential-specific requests with distinct presentation events.
Assessment examines only the content of the status response and ignores privacy-significant metadata created by making the lookup.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.

dispositions.potential_impact: Former member and relying service; disclosure of attempted use or relationship.

dispositions.sections: Submit Security & Privacy: Consent/purpose, Retention; Manifest directoryDisclosure
dispositions.local_proposition: Applicant legitimately discloses verified or self-asserted evidence for admission.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Successful application permits unrelated directory use, profiling or indefinite retention.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires legitimate original disclosure and successful presentation, distinct later processing and absent applicable purpose/authority; registryConsent only covers registry publication, not blanket reuse.
dispositions.trigger: A downstream party performs secondary processing and relies on the fact of successful presentation rather than establishing an applicable purpose, policy, authority, or other governance basis for that later use.
falsification: The system treats successful presentation as sufficient basis for materially different downstream processing without evaluating the applicable purpose or policy.
Data is retained or transferred beyond an applicable bound while the decision record continues to represent the processing as within the original relying purpose.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate separate purpose and authority, minimize retention and distinguish refused/admitted applications; no presumption that lawful audit is prohibited.
dispositions.comparison: limited: explicit source purpose restriction already captures mechanism; ceremony locates subsequent processing.

dispositions.local_proposition: Admission and removal evidence may be legitimately collected and retained under applicable audit rules.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Initial legitimate disclosure authorizes unrelated use of retained records after departure.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires original legitimate disclosure and successful verification, distinct later processing beyond applicable purpose/audience/retention, no separate governance basis. Authorized audit retention is a control.
dispositions.trigger: A downstream party performs secondary processing and relies on the fact of successful presentation rather than establishing an applicable purpose, policy, authority, or other governance basis for that later use.
falsification: The system treats successful presentation as sufficient basis for materially different downstream processing without evaluating the applicable purpose or policy.
Data is retained or transferred beyond an applicable bound while the decision record continues to represent the processing as within the original relying purpose.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Apply disposition and retention policy; preserve only justified evidence, reject unsupported secondary use; do not downgrade erasure.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member; profiling or unauthorized retention.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: evaluates purpose continuity across admission and separation.

dispositions.local_proposition: Authorized issuers/community may choose identifiers and credential/proof configurations.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Authorized participants necessarily preserve applicant unlinkability.

falsification: The system returns PASS for unlinkability while issuer-controlled or operator-controlled metadata consistently links otherwise separate interactions.
Assessment assumes that an authoritative participant preserves privacy merely because that participant is authorized to issue or operate the relevant component.

dispositions.sections: Submit Requested attributes, Correlation and Data carried; VTI-CMP-060–064
dispositions.local_proposition: Individual attributes, VP and review metadata may each be justified.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Combined evidence is privacy-minimal because each item is individually justified.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires multiple linkable disclosures, per-item acceptability and untested combined privacy property; actual sensitive inference or identity narrowing must be evaluated.
dispositions.trigger: The combined disclosure set materially narrows identity, enables profiling, or reveals a sensitive inference while the system treats independent minimization of each element as sufficient privacy evidence.
falsification: The system returns PASS for minimization solely because each disclosed element is individually justified while their combination materially enables identification or profiling.
Privacy analysis omits readily available joins among disclosed facts that change the sensitivity or identifiability of the combined result.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Assess joint VP/attributes/metadata against purpose and observer knowledge; avoid unnecessary fields and respect selective disclosure.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: joint disclosure evaluation directly tests composition.

dispositions.sections: Submit Retention: VP and vpClaims; VTI-CMP-060–064
dispositions.local_proposition: Durable application records preserve decision evidence.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Audit value justifies indefinite or broadly aggregated retention of all linkable evidence.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires persistable verification artifacts, joinable identifiers/metadata and no established necessity for broad retention; actual excessive retention/correlation must be evidenced. Source recommends disposal policy but supplies no universal lifetime.
dispositions.trigger: Verification artefacts are persisted or aggregated beyond the justified purpose or retention boundary and become a durable dataset from which otherwise separate interactions can be reconstructed or correlated.
falsification: The system reports PASS for privacy while retaining verification artefacts beyond the established purpose or retention boundary and those artefacts permit cross-context reconstruction.
Audit or assurance value is asserted as a blanket justification for retaining raw or linkable artefacts when less correlating evidence would satisfy the same stated purpose.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate retention separately for VP, projection, attributes and audit references; retain minimum justified evidence and record disposal policy.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant including refused applicant; durable profiling or exposure.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: links multiple stores and later use; source already identifies durable VP/projection risk.

dispositions.local_proposition: Audit evidence can legitimately survive certain record disposal.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Audit survival authorizes indefinite aggregation of admission, status and departure records.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires persistent verification artifacts joinable across contexts, no positive necessity for broad retention and actual excess aggregation; erasure and audit obligations must be reconciled, not presumed incompatible.
dispositions.trigger: Verification artefacts are persisted or aggregated beyond the justified purpose or retention boundary and become a durable dataset from which otherwise separate interactions can be reconstructed or correlated.
falsification: The system reports PASS for privacy while retaining verification artefacts beyond the established purpose or retention boundary and those artefacts permit cross-context reconstruction.
Audit or assurance value is asserted as a blanket justification for retaining raw or linkable artefacts when less correlating evidence would satisfy the same stated purpose.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Document per-artifact purpose/bound, retain minimally correlating evidence where sufficient, respect applicable erasure; qualify historical gaps.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member; durable affiliation reconstruction or loss of contestability.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: evaluates retention and correlation over relationship lifecycle.

limitations: Conditional documentary hypotheses, not observed privacy violations.
Privacy objectives, actual observers, data joins and retention necessity must be established for the deployment; authorized within-context correlation is not inherently a failure.
DTF-032 requires credential/presentation securing-mechanism premises, not merely stable task envelope identifiers.
VTI snapshot separately pinned; compatibility not asserted.
Per-precondition adversarial review and final matrix validation remain pending.
Gate C adversarial narrowing: do not promote a merely imaginable extension beyond the selected profile into a conditional candidate. Not established does not imply safety.
